$comment: Not in Sketch swatches/styles: carried over from silica-desktop docs/design/amalfi (tokens.json, motion.md). Colours, typography and glass styles come from the Sketch export.

grid.rule: every frame x, y, width, height is a multiple of 4; no half points; text frames on whole points

controlHeights.note: one scale for every control; toolbar items are 36 (user decision 2026-10-17, macOS capsules are 38); never resize a control inside a bar

controlIcons.note: user decision 2026-10-17: Amalfi symbols draw ink = size x 20/24, so a 20 pt symbol draws ~17 pt like macOS; never smaller. Icons are set in the Silica Symbols font (silica-icons fonts/): font size = icon size

radii.cornerStyle: smooth (continuous), smoothing 0.6, on every rounded surface

use.1: small raised controls (switch thumb, slider thumb, secondary push button)
use.2: small raised controls on a surface and objects that are not glass

onPhoto.use: Light appearance: every text and status item drawn straight on the wallpaper (lock screen date, name, hint, address, labels, Status Bar Lock Screen context); Dark draws none

Glass/Regular.use: the one material of controls, bars, menus, popovers, tooltips, alerts, panels, banners, the Dock. Provisional values between the former Regular and Thick (Apple publishes none)

Glass/Clear.use: nearly transparent glass: the lens a control grows into while pressed or dragged (switch thumb, slider thumb, segmented selection) and overlays on media (Apple's clear variant); controls at rest use Regular

Blur/Sidebar Title Bar.use: title bar section over a sidebar in split title bars; sidebar rows scroll under it

Glass/Lock.use: lock screen: password field, help button, action buttons; Increase Contrast and Reduce Transparency variants are also the Status Bar plates (status-bar.md). Kit styles <App>/Glass/Lock, <App>/Glass/Lock Increase Contrast, <App>/Glass/Lock Reduce Transparency

reduceTransparency.note: the materials fallback: tint over Surface/Window, rims kept, no blur

Glass/Clock.use: lock screen clock digits only (Lock Clock); clipped to the glyphs

Scrim/Lock Light.use: Light appearance lock screen, over the dimmed wallpaper, under everything else (provisional legibility aid)

states.disabled: whole control at 35 % opacity, no hover/press; a select-one segmented control keeps its selection visible (dimmed with the rest)

windowControls.note: measured values from docs/spec/windows.md, kept on purpose (user decision)

switch.note: thumb inset 2 pt on every side at every size; pressed thumb stretches 4 pt toward the middle (user decision 2026-10-16)

snappy.use: hover/press, lens grow, switch thumb, checkbox

panel.use: Faro results growth, menus and popovers height, sheets

window.use: window open/close scale, minimise, Mission Control layouts

morph.use: shape morphs: Faro buttons, Launcher <-> Faro, Control Center detail

motion.reducedMotion: springs become fade.quick cross-fades, no overshoot, no scale; bounces off
